The first figure is the sole upright normalization anchor. Do not alter or regenerate the existing atlas or action frames.
Composition: every figure is fully separated by generous transparent gaps inside its own quarter cell. Keep the current 96x80 native safe-area intent: new figures should be compact enough to fit a 94x77 region at the same physical scale. Do not extend arms straight vertically above the existing standing-height silhouette; do not shrink or resize individual poses to make them fit. Feet and body pivots should remain coherent. Exact row-major frame content: 48 upright neutral standing guard matching the original idle height and proportions exactly; 49 visibly airborne air-punch anticipation with compact knees and fists prepared; 50 visibly airborne air-punch active with one fist extended forward, compact readable silhouette; 51 visibly airborne air-punch retract returning toward airborne guard; 52 visibly airborne air-kick anticipation with knee raised and body tucked; 53 visibly airborne air-kick active with one leg extended forward but contained within the cell; 54 visibly airborne air-kick retract with bent leg returning; 55 compact neutral airborne/apex guard with knees bent; 56 thrower contact/grip with both arms reaching toward an opponent position while remaining a single fighter and no opponent or prop; 57 thrower release/turn with clear torso rotation and throwing force, no opponent or prop; 58 victim lifted and off balance with contained limbs, single fighter only; 59 victim ground impact with head LEFT; 60 knockdown launch/recoil; 61 knockdown fall diagonally with head LEFT; 62 grounded get-up with planted hand and foot; 63 wake-up guard returning to neutral.

Preserve clothing construction, copper/ginger hair and beard and crimson waistcoat in every frame. No translated duplicate body, no programmatic limb deformation, no fake silhouette, no relabeled grounded pose.
Hard constraints: actual transparency with alpha, exactly 16 connected figures, 4x4 layout, no labels, text, watermark, shadows, projectile, energy, motion streaks, extra characters, opponent, props, cropped limbs, black background or photorealism. Keep every frame original artwork inspired only by arcade animation rhythm, not copied commercial sprites.
